module savings.schedule
  purpose: Print a yearly savings balance schedule with compound interest.

import std.console
import std.environment

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, environment
  purpose: Read command-line arguments and print the savings schedule.

  let args be environment.arguments()
  if args.length is not 3 then
    console.print_error("Usage: savings <starting_amount> <yearly_rate_percent> <years>")
    environment.exit(1)
  end

  let starting_text be args.at(0) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing starting amount")
  let rate_text be args.at(1) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing yearly rate")
  let years_text be args.at(2) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing years")

  let starting be starting_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid starting amount")
  let rate_percent be rate_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid yearly rate")
  let years be years_text.to_integer() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid years")

  if starting is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "starting amount must be non-negative")
  end
  if rate_percent is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "yearly rate must be non-negative")
  end
  if years is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "years must be non-negative")
  end

  console.print("Year,Balance")
  print_schedule(starting: starting, rate_percent: rate_percent, years: years)
end

function print_schedule(starting: Decimal, rate_percent: Decimal, years: Integer)
  purpose: Print each year's balance with compound interest.

  let rate_multiplier be 1 + (rate_percent / 100)
  let mutable balance be starting
  let mutable year be 0

  repeat until year is greater than years
    let formatted be format_balance(balance)
    console.print("{year},{formatted}")
    set year to year + 1
    set balance to balance * rate_multiplier
  end
end

function format_balance(balance: Decimal) returns Text
  purpose: Format a balance to exactly two decimal places.
  example: format_balance(balance: 100.5) is "100.50"

  let rounded be balance.rounded(places: 2)
  let text be rounded.to_text()
  
  if text.contains(".") then
    return text
  otherwise
    return "{text}.00"
  end
end

public type AppError
  has detail: Text
end

    console.print("{year},{formatted}")
    set year to year + 1
    set balance to balance * (1 + rate_decimal)
  end

function format_balance(balance: Decimal) returns Text
  purpose: Format a balance to exactly two decimal places.
  example: format_balance(balance: 1234.5) is "1234.50"

  let rounded be balance.rounded(places: 2)
  let text be rounded.to_text()
  let parts be text.split(".")
  let integer_part be parts.at(0) otherwise fail
  let decimal_part be
    if parts.length is 1 then
      "00"
    otherwise
      let part be parts.at(1) otherwise fail
      if part.length is 1 then
        part + "0"
      otherwise if part.length is 2 then
        part
      otherwise
        part.take(2)
      end
    end
  end
  return integer_part + "." + decimal_part
end

public type AppError
  has detail: Text

  let starting be starting_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid starting amount")
  let rate_percent be rate_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid yearly rate")

  if starting is less than 0 then

  end

  end

  console.print("Year,Balance")
  let rate_decimal be rate_percent / 100
  let mutable balance be starting
  let mutable year be 0

  repeat until year is greater than years
    let formatted be format_balance(balance)
    console.print("{year},{formatted}")
    set balance to balance * (1 + rate_decimal)
    set year to year + 1
  end
end

function format_balance(amount: Decimal) returns Text
  purpose: Format a decimal amount to two decimal places.
  example: format_balance(amount: 1234.5) is "1234.50"

  let rounded be amount.rounded(places: 2)
  let text be rounded.to_text()
  let parts be text.split(".")
  let integer_part be parts.at(0) otherwise fail
  let decimal_part be
    if parts.length is 2 then
      parts.at(1) otherwise fail
    otherwise
      ""
    end
  end

  let padded_decimal be decimal_part.pad_right(length: 2, with: "0")
  return "{integer_part}.{padded_decimal}"
end

public type AppError
  has detail: Text
end
